answer.evidence: The fence posts have clearly visible top surfaces spanning rows 2-4 (3 rows tall in lighter tone), and the horizontal rails each show a 2-row top surface with darker front faces beneath.

Both horizontal rails show a distinct 3-row foreshortened top surface (lighter brown, rows 3-5 and 9-11) above their south faces (darker brown, rows 6-7 and 12-13). The posts also show clear 3-row top caps (rows 2-4).

The wooden posts show clear 3-row tall top surfaces at rows 2-4 above their south-facing vertical shafts, and the horizontal rails similarly show distinct top planes (rows 4-5 and 10-11) distinct from their shaded south faces.
